findings.claim: 10-K 載明服務主要以 MSA 等合約提供；搜尋未見 MSA 談判方式或改為直接對資料中心營運商簽約的變動紀錄。
findings.excerpt: Our services are typically provided pursuant to master service agreements (MSAs), repair and maintenance contracts and fixed price and non-fixed price construction and engineering contracts.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 未見訂閱化／D2C／平台化轉移；僅見向製造與預製延伸（轉述來源，未讀原頁）。
